directive.quote: Lane 2, the setup screens leave the engine: move them to a Workshop tool (or tools) with their reader code. Move code, never rewrite it. Carry the original tests and their assertions.

targets.baseline_commit_message: set-up-my-account: the Get started steps and screen, moved byte for byte from trillion

preserve: every decision, word and fail-closed rule of the source: an unread fact or rule source is unknown, never done

setupInstalls(origin) is not called: its owner (setup-installs.mjs) reads harness and placement records that did not move; the install words come in the request (installs), as the engine's port already dropped them
